evidence_backed_direction.retained_construct: Fresh Review verified the alias-safe source-tied then runtime-split lm_head construction, complete BF16 embedding preservation, byte-identical independent 169-Linear V4 construction, 169/169 V3-relative source-space reconstruction improvement, and legal grouped Dynamic Scale32 execution at all 312 activation boundaries.
evidence_backed_direction.measured_failure: V4 reduced aggregate unweighted BF16 weight-reconstruction SSE from V3 2987.0298056936317 to 2387.058149454451 and strictly improved all 169 tensors, yet exact non-evaluator token identity decreased from V3 3/8 to V4 2/8. Lower source-space weight SSE is therefore not a sufficient detector for the immutable exact-sequence objective.
evidence_backed_direction.replacement_hypothesis: Retain the exact V4 storage and accelerator format, but optimize the row Scale32 records and tensor codebook against exact per-input-channel activation-energy weights derived only from the frozen four public calibration prompts under the pinned BF16 model. This directs the fixed 4-bit representation toward weight errors that are exercised most strongly by the selected chat contract without adding runtime metadata or using official inputs.
evidence_backed_direction.distinctness: V4 minimizes unweighted source-space weight SSE from pinned weights only. V5 first captures and freezes exact BF16 activation-energy records for every Linear input channel, then performs a new deterministic weighted alternating minimization. It is not a replay, parameter tweak, prompt-specific runtime policy, wider payload, exception table, or repair under the V4 candidate ID.

calibration_statistics.permitted_model: pinned BF16 source model before any weight or activation quantization
calibration_statistics.permitted_positions: all prompt-prefill positions and the deterministic BF16 greedy rollout of at most six generated tokens for the four frozen calibration prompts
calibration_statistics.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
calibration_statistics.statistic: For each of the 169 Linear modules and each input channel j, capture every finite BF16 input x and accumulate H_j=sum(x^2) exactly on a module-local dyadic integer lattice; use max(H_j,1) so an unobserved channel remains represented.
calibration_statistics.normalization: Divide the complete positive integer H vector by its greatest common divisor only; no floating-point normalization, clipping, percentile, prompt weighting, or learned parameter is permitted.
calibration_statistics.required_identity: Two independent BF16 calibration-statistic captures must produce byte-identical per-module H vectors, prompt token hashes, generated calibration token arrays, position counts, and aggregate manifest hashes.

candidate_state_construction.initial_invariant: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter object and storage immediately after pinned-model load
candidate_state_construction.separation_rule: Before weight construction, replace only lm_head.weight with a detached byte-identical non-trainable clone and set only the in-memory candidate configuration tie_word_embeddings field to false.
candidate_state_construction.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linear weights plus the separated lm_head weight
candidate_state_construction.post_quantization_embedding_invariant: The original embedding Parameter object, storage pointer, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 byte stream remain unchanged.

weight_policy.packing: row-major output row then input lane; even flat index in low nibble and odd flat index in high nibble

row_scale.format: existing normalized unsigned-Q1.15 Scale32 significand plus signed exponent record
row_scale.all_zero_weight_row_rule: use the frozen all-zero Scale32 record and payload index of the codepoint nearest zero

weighted_joint_construction_algorithm.data_source: pinned BF16 weights plus the frozen exact calibration H vectors only
weighted_joint_construction_algorithm.initial_state: Freshly recompute the complete V4 eight-iteration unweighted joint row-Scale32/tensor-codebook result from pinned BF16 weights; do not import a V4 candidate manifest or mutable state.
weighted_joint_construction_algorithm.weighted_objective: For each tensor, minimize sum over output rows i and input channels j of H_j*(weight_ij-reconstruction_ij)^2 using exact integer comparisons on a common dyadic lattice.
weighted_joint_construction_algorithm.assignment_step: Assign every BF16 weight to the nearest reconstructed level row_scale times codepoint_q4_4 divided by 16; exact-distance ties select the lower index. Positive H_j does not alter the per-weight nearest-level boundary but remains part of every row-scale and codebook cost.
weighted_joint_construction_algorithm.row_scale_step: With indices and codepoints fixed, form the exact weighted dyadic least-squares ideal 16*sum(H_j*weight_j*codepoint_j)/sum(H_j*codepoint_j^2). Constrain it to the no-overflow lower bound absmax*16/127 and the legal Scale32 range. Evaluate the legal records bracketing that ideal, their immediate normalized-significand neighbors, and the prior record using weighted row SSE; choose minimum weighted SSE, then smaller positive scale, then smaller packed record on ties.
weighted_joint_construction_algorithm.codebook_step: With indices and row scales fixed, accumulate exact H_j-weighted per-cluster quadratic costs for every signed-Q4.4 value -128 through +127. Use dynamic programming to choose the globally minimum-cost strictly increasing 16-value codebook. Empty clusters retain their prior codepoint as a hard constraint; total-cost ties choose the lexicographically smaller codebook.
weighted_joint_construction_algorithm.iteration_acceptance: Reassign after each row-scale and codebook update. The exact activation-energy-weighted tensor objective may not increase from the preceding outer iteration; a violation fails closed. Execute all eight iterations even after a fixed point.

pre_attempt_model_only_gate.required_weighted_baseline: Freshly apply the exact V5 H vectors to the freshly reconstructed V4 candidate and record per-tensor plus aggregate weighted objectives before V5 optimization.

activation_policy.payload: signed A8 symmetric range -127 through +127 with -128 reserved
activation_policy.base_record_source: the same frozen authenticated activation Scale32 significands used by V4
activation_policy.selection_rule: For each live finite group, preserve the base activation Scale32 significand and choose the minimum integer exponent delta in [-24,+24] whose effective exponent remains in [-24,+4] and covers every lane without saturation.
activation_policy.failure_rule: If no legal delta covers a finite group, fail closed; never clip, saturate, or mutate the base activation significand.

accelerator_facing_format.weight_payload_transport: existing 128-bit external-memory read channel; packed 4-bit indices retain the existing byte count
accelerator_facing_format.row_scale_transport: existing one 32-bit Scale32 record per output row; only record values may change
accelerator_facing_format.codebook_transport: one aligned 128-bit read beat per Linear tensor before its weight stream
accelerator_facing_format.compute_primitive: signed A8 activation multiplied by signed Q4.4 codepoint, accumulated as an integer product, then combined with the row Scale32 and fixed fractional shift four

pre_attempt_closure.calibration_statistics_gate: Two independent exact BF16 captures over the same four frozen calibration prompts must produce byte-identical H vectors, token arrays, position counts, and manifests for all 169 Linear modules.
pre_attempt_closure.weighted_model_gate: All 169 tensors must be non-regressing against the freshly measured V4 activation-energy-weighted baseline and the aggregate weighted objective must strictly improve.
pre_attempt_closure.non_evaluator_quality_gate: The same frozen eight non-evaluator inputs must achieve 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching BF16 response-gate outcomes before an official marker may be created; the four additional inputs remain construction-blind holdouts.
pre_attempt_closure.dynamic_gate: A fresh V5 candidate must cover all 312 named activation boundaries with legal deltas, zero saturation, zero clipping, and no reserved -128 payload.

risk_register: Activation-energy weighting is an evidence-backed proxy, not proof of token identity; the eight-input exact gate remains mandatory and precedes official execution.
The four calibration prompts influence construction, so all four additional non-evaluator prompts remain construction-blind holdouts and must independently match exactly.
Exact activation-statistic capture and weighted integer objectives increase build complexity and must prove byte-identical independent capture and construction.

No calibration statistic is stored or transported at runtime; any product-image metadata growth, prompt-dependent runtime selection, sparse exception table, wider payload, or extra row record is forbidden.

Changing row Scale32 and codebook values preserves geometry but will require accelerator-facing agreement checks and focused RTL regression only after numerical policy acceptance and Manager stage advance.
